stage_notes.sprout: add two small clearly visible dark eyes with tiny white glints on the root just below the leaves; red pupils in the black eyes

garlic.final: a garlic bulb with tall flat green leaves

onion.final: an onion bulb with tubular green leaves

stage_notes.sprout: make it a small bushy sprout with several tiny leaves instead of two
make the leaves thin curling tendrils and add a tiny wooden trellis behind the sprout, keep it small and sprout-like

stage_notes.sprout: add a small drip of dark red blood hanging from the tip of the left leaf

wolfsbane.final: a tall wolfsbane plant with hooded purple flowers

wisp_lettuce.final: a pale lettuce head glowing faintly

brine_bulb.colour: pale sea green with salt crystals

stage_notes.sprout: replace the water drop with a teardrop-shaped light blue bulb sitting between the two leaves at the top of the centre stalk, with a small white glisten highlight; no drip

foxglove.final: a tall foxglove with purple-pink bell flowers

stage_notes.sprout: two small black eyes and a larger black open mouth on the drooping bud

bat_orchid.final: a black bat-shaped orchid with long whiskers
